title: Toileting at Night in Older Adults: Light to Maximize Balance, Minimize Insomnia
brief_summary: To examine the change in balance that occurs in older individuals when exposed to different colored lights at night.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Aged 55-85
* Stable health
* Normal color vision

Exclusion Criteria:

* Alcohol abuse
* Depression
* Sleep disorders
* Smoking
* Use of illegal drugs
